title: Lecture-only quiz
description: Questions built only from what the instructor covered in class (coverage lecture-only or lecture+book), written from the lecture's framing. This template unit has only six questions, so all three quizzes reuse them in a different order; a real unit lists 20 different-looking predictions per quiz.

title: Lecture + book quiz (primary prediction)
description: Questions grounded in lecture content AND the corresponding book material; the most accurate reflection of testable material. Exactly one quiz has "primary": true; it is the default tab and the one the home page links to.

title: Book-only quiz
description: Questions drawn entirely from the assigned chapters, including material the lecture did not reach (coverage book-only).
